name: Kimi K3.1 Pro
notes: 2.8T-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model (104B activated), natively multimodal. Announced 2026-10-24; open weights released 2026-11-02. Prices are Moonshot first-party API rates for the kimi-k3.1-pro endpoint per 1M tokens (cache-miss input; cached input is billed at $0.20/MTok). A high-speed variant, kimi-k3.1-pro-highspeed, is priced separately.
